request.operator_instruction: the whole point is to use chunking plus overlapping sliding and global remapping with extraction. let's get it working
request.objective: Build and run a chunked extraction pipeline: sliding windows with overlap, map-keyed entity requests, parsing of the chat-completions payload, re-mapping of local spans to global document offsets by re-locating the returned text, and deduplication of values found in more than one window. Report per-window recall so zero-entity windows are visible rather than hidden.
acceptance_criteria: windows overlap and every window is sent as one call carrying exactly one map-keyed entities object
the response body is parsed at choices[0].message.content and json-decoded before entities are read
every value carries a global offset that re-locates its own text in the full document, or is marked ungrounded
a value returned by two overlapping windows appears once in the merged output
per-window entity counts are recorded, including windows that return nothing
total spend is printed and stays under 0.02 USD

authorization.scope: Diagnostic pipeline in the scratch area. No product code, no change to extract-test/run.mjs, no change to documents or fixtures.
